cases.description: GoodRelations retold as speech; business entities, offerings, price specifications, warranties and products.
input: so GoodRelations is really about offerings and business entities
a business entity is either a person or an organization
and uh the business entity offers the offerings
an offering has a price specification and um it accepts payment methods
there are three types of price specification unit price specifications delivery charge specifications and payment charge specifications
the offering also has a warranty promise and the warranty promise has a warranty scope
and it includes a product or service which has a brand

cases.description: PROV-O retold as speech; the three starting points, their relations, agent kinds, entity kinds and qualified associations.
input: um so the provenance ontology has three starting points entities activities and agents
an activity uses entities and uh it generates entities too
an entity is attributed to an agent
and agents are persons organizations or software agents
a plan is a kind of entity and so is a collection and an empty collection is a kind of collection
each activity has an association and the association has a role
oh and revisions and quotations they're both kinds of derivation

cases.description: DCAT retold as speech; a five-level drill-down from catalogs to relationship roles.
input: okay so DCAT is basically about catalogs
a catalog has catalog records datasets and um data services
each dataset has one or more distributions and uh a dataset series is a kind of dataset
the data services they serve datasets
and each catalog record has a primary topic which is a catalogued resource
under the catalogued resource there are relationships and each of them has a role

cases.description: A recording shaped like the owner's; a service line split in two, billing attributes, a buyer of both and its divisions.

the cloud services are split into hosting and uh support
hosting is billed monthly
and the support ones are charged per hour
Brightline Retail buys both of them

cases.description: Long monologue; grouping, a corrected count, a correction of the subject, 5 levels.
input: okay so um let me walk you through how mirelle stores works uh we are a fashion retailer and we run stores and an online shop the stores are um grouped into three formats flagship stores high street stores and outlet stores and uh every store has a store manager and a stockroom and the stockroom receives deliveries from the distribution centre right so the distribution centre um it handles inbound and outbound and inbound consists of receiving put-away and quality sampling and uh outbound consists of picking packing and dispatch and dispatch hands parcels to the carrier oh and the online shop sorry the online shop not the stores the online shop has a returns portal and the returns portal creates a return label and um customers can join our loyalty programme which has two tiers silver and gold no wait three tiers silver gold and platinum and gold members get free delivery what else um buying and merchandising plans the collections and each collection is made of product ranges and a product range contains styles and a style comes in sizes and colours I think that's about it
